description: Call a path on the application on a schedule, such as a nightly cleanup. Anyone can send the x-antideploy-cron header the call carries, so an endpoint that does real work should also check a secret of the app's own.

path.description: A path on this application, starting with a slash.

schedule.description: Five-field cron in UTC, like "0 3 * * *", or @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly.

name: add_schedule
title: Schedule a job
